caption: The drawing depicts five separate gold-colored jewelry items on a plain, light beige background. At the top center, there is a single brooch or pin shaped like a flower, composed of overlapping petal-like segments. Below it, on the left side, is a pair of earrings with long, dangling designs formed from multiple gold leaves, each having a small flower motif at the center and a circular gold bead at the top connected to a hook. On the right side, there is a second pair of earrings, smaller and shorter than the first pair, featuring a central star or flower pattern, leaf-like decorations extending down, and a small spherical bead hanging from the base. At the bottom right corner of the drawing, there is a signature that reads "V. Van Voris." All objects are depicted in shades of gold and brown, and each item is rendered in fine detail, showing texture and dimensionality.
title: Brooch and Earrings
